blocks.text:
**2027 itinerary: 3 days / 2 nights.**

Iguazú can be added to a longer journey through South America or enjoyed as a short standalone break. Over 2 days of excursions, you will see the falls from both banks. The Brazilian side offers broad views of the cascades, while the Argentine trails and walkways bring you closer to the water and lead to the Devil’s Throat.

The first day includes the Bird Park. After the roar of the falls, the walk continues amid the greenery of the Atlantic Forest and aviaries filled with colourful birds. If you would like to add an adventure on the water, the Macuco Safari can be booked separately.

## Hotel and price

Prices are in USD per person. Accommodation at Vivaz Cataratas 4*, Luxury Room, 2 nights, BB + services as per the itinerary. A hotel of a similar category may be substituted.

| Category | Hotel and accommodation | SGL | DBL | TRP |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4* | Vivaz Cataratas, Luxury Room, 2 nights, BB + services | $1500 | $862 | $764 |

SGL means single occupancy, DBL double occupancy and TRP triple occupancy. BB means breakfast at the hotel. The minimum price of $764 applies to TRP. The Macuco Safari is charged separately.
